page_placements.theme: Generalization diagnostics provide information beyond training fit

record.tranche_reason: The study trains natural-label and random-label image-network cohorts and measures held-out accuracy and joint completion scores, bearing on random-label fitting and its test accuracy. It does not reproduce the original interpolation analysis in full: its principal measurement is a frozen-feature affine-readout completion score.
record.gate_note: The random-label cohort is the study's own result relevant to V1. The paper states that its random-label cohort interpolates the child set under the same architecture, optimiser, bank, and seeds as the natural-label cohort; Appendix D defines interpolation as correct classification of every child input. The joint-score association with held-out random-label accuracy is near zero. Other discussions of Zhang et al. are cited prior work and are not rows. Hessian-rescaling results do not bear on these claim versions.
record.test_reason: The random-label MNIST cohort bears on V1: Figure 1 shows held-out accuracy near chance, and Appendix D requires child-set interpolation under the matched SGD protocol. The recorded bank-score correlation itself does not test V1.
record.authors_conclusion: The record accurately paraphrases the random-label conclusion: uniform-bank feasibility increases, its association with held-out random-label accuracy centres near zero, and the estimator requires a task-specific interpretation.
record.recipe_differences: Uses trained image networks and randomized labels, but measures frozen-feature affine-readout completion and score-accuracy association rather than the original work's training-error and test-error demonstration. The text states matched architecture, optimiser, bank and seeds across natural and random cohorts.
record.method_sensitivity: The random-label result is specific to MNIST, one fixed random relabelling of each partition, a uniform joint bank, and the stated frozen penultimate-feature protocol.

fits_no_version.finding: Mean joint-bank feasibility rises from 0.287 to 0.420, while its correlation with random-label accuracy is 0.058.
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: Uniform arbitrary-label completion feasibility is higher after random-label training but does not predict held-out random-label accuracy in this cohort.

record.problems: The random-label association is from one fixed random relabelling per partition and the text reports the score-accuracy association and mean bank score, not a numerical training-error or test-error result. The paper says the random-label task, learned policy, representation and relevant demand law all changed, limiting interpretation of this as a direct cross-task comparison.
record.rows_left_out: No cited Zhang et al. results included. The function-preserving rescaling experiment in Section 5.1 and Table 7 concerns raw Hessian curvature, not any listed claim version.

untested.parts: Achieved training errors and failed-seed counts are not explicitly reported. Appendix D's interpolation requirement is a protocol criterion, not a numerical outcome.
Relative training time and convergence as label corruption increases.
Fitting shuffled, independently permuted, or Gaussian-noise inputs.
Training and test errors across intermediate label-corruption fractions.
Effects of adding or removing explicit regularization.
Learning real patterns before memorizing noise over training.

missing.what: Random-label held-out accuracy plotted around 0.094–0.108, near ten-class chance; record separately from the bank-score correlation.

record.verdict_notes: The supplied text does not explicitly state that every random-label seed attained interpolation. Completed cohorts plus the interpolation requirement suggest this, but the requirement alone should not become an observed zero-training-error row. Missing training-error reporting is not evidence against V1.

versions.untested_parts: No separate reported test-error-at-chance result beyond the random-label cohort's held-out accuracy association; the cohort uses separate fixed random relabellings of training and test partitions.

rows.subject: MNIST random-label cohort (100 networks; aggregate)
rows.operation_detail: Trained on one fixed random relabelling of the training partition; separate fixed random relabelling used for test partition. Input splits, architecture, optimiser, bank and seeds match the natural-label cohort.

conditions.value: fixed random relabelling of training partition; separate fixed fixed random relabelling of test partition

rows.measure: Mean joint bank score JH and its rank correlation with held-out random-label accuracy
rows.note: Aggregate result for the 100-network random-label cohort. The text says the cohort uses the same architecture and optimiser as the natural-label cohort and that the random-label association centres near zero; it does not report an explicit aggregate training-error value here. Appendix D specifies the interpolation requirement, but not the cohort's attained error in this result passage.
rows.check: Joint-bank feasibility and its correlation with accuracy measure representation freedom, not achieved training error or chance-level test accuracy. A near-zero correlation cannot establish either component of V1.

relationships.condition: Held-out accuracy component; 100 MNIST networks trained with fixed random labels
relationships.reason: Figure 1 shows random-label accuracy around 10%, the ten-class chance level. This verdict comes from the figure, missing from R1; it does not establish achieved training error.
relationships.display_finding: Held-out accuracy was around 10% across 100 networks, matching ten-class chance performance.
